senses.en: After the time or event just mentioned

ex.en: The quiz expected us to recognize thereafter in a lecture clip.
ex.zh: 小测要求我们在一段讲座录音里认出此后。

ex.en: A reading on historical change uses thereafter when the author sets up the main claim.
ex.zh: 一篇关于历史变迁的阅读在提出主要主张时用到了此后。

tip: 正式用语，指前文时间点之后；日常常用after that。

senses.en: A metal made by combining metals or adding other elements.
To combine a metal with another element.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on aluminium alloy.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论铝合金。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of aluminium alloy.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得铝合金这个例子。

tip: 名词重音在前；动词常读/əˈlɔɪ/。

senses.en: The wide tidal mouth of a river meeting the sea.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a river estuary.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论河口。

ex.en: The author returns to a river estuary when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了河口。

tip: 强调受潮汐影响的入海河口，不等于delta三角洲。

senses.en: An introductory section explaining a book's purpose or background.
To introduce something by saying or writing something beforehand.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about preface remarks with.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于以…作为讲话的开场白的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around preface remarks with.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕以…作为讲话的开场白展开说明。

col: preface remarks with｜以…作为讲话的开场白
tip: 书的preface通常由作者写；foreword常由他人撰写。

senses.en: Having a fault that prevents something from working properly.

ex.en: I copied defective product into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把有缺陷的产品抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects defective product with a larger point about technological change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把有缺陷的产品和关于技术变革的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常形容产品、零件或系统有缺陷，不能正常运作。

senses.en: work out the meaning of unclear writing or coded information

ex.en: The lab instructions say to decipher a code.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求破译密码。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to decipher a code.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来破译密码。

tip: 只作动词；既可指破译密码，也可指辨认潦草字迹。

senses.en: Trusted as accurate because of expert knowledge.
Showing confidence and an ability to command respect.

ex.en: I copied an authoritative source into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把权威来源抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used an authoritative source to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用权威来源来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 勿混authoritarian：后者指专制的。

senses.en: by everyone or in every place or situation

ex.en: In the methods section, students learn to universally accepted.
ex.zh: 在方法部分，学生学习普遍接受的。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will universally accepted when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会普遍接受的。

tip: 语气强于generally，常强调人人或处处如此。

senses.en: unwilling to talk openly about your thoughts or feelings

ex.en: I copied reticent about personal matters into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把不愿谈论私事抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The author returns to reticent about personal matters when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了不愿谈论私事。

col: reticent about personal matters｜不愿谈论私事
tip: 侧重不愿开口或透露信息，不等于一般的不情愿。

senses.en: The children or young of a person, animal, or plant.

ex.en: Office hours began with produce offspring.
ex.zh: 答疑从繁育后代开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used produce offspring to explain a pattern in the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用繁育后代来解释自然科学中的一种模式。

col: protect their offspring｜保护它们的幼崽
tip: 单复数同形；谈人的子女时比children正式。

senses.en: To cause a reaction, feeling, or event.
To deliberately make someone angry or likely to react.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer provoke debate during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时引发争论。

ex.en: When the class discussed social change, the speaker told us to provoke debate.
ex.zh: 全班讨论社会变迁时，讲者让我们引发争论。

col: provoke someone into doing something｜激得某人做某事
tip: provoke不只指激怒，也常指引发讨论或反应。

senses.en: To make someone extremely annoyed or frustrated.

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to exasperate commuters.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何使通勤者恼火。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to exasperate commuters.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来使通勤者恼火。

tip: 勿混淆exacerbate：后者表示使问题恶化。

senses.en: A different offer made in response to an earlier offer.

ex.en: After the lecture, we used counter-offer in a sentence of our own.
ex.zh: 讲座之后，我们在自己的句子里用了还价。

ex.en: Students who can explain counter-offer usually follow the rest of a lecture on economic policy.
ex.zh: 能解释还价的学生，通常跟得上一节关于经济政策的讲座。

tip: 可写作counteroffer；不仅指还价，也指修改条件。

senses.en: The act of officially choosing someone or something for a purpose.
An official name or title given to someone or something.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on official designation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论正式名称；官方认定。

ex.en: The reading connects official designation with a larger point about public institutions.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把正式名称；官方认定和关于公共制度的一个更大的问题联系起来。

col: official designation｜正式名称；官方认定
tip: designation as后接身份；也可指正式名称或职称。

senses.en: subjects studying human culture, such as history, literature, and philosophy

ex.en: The textbook introduces arts and humanities in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了艺术与人文学科。

ex.en: A campus survey used arts and humanities to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用艺术与人文学科来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

col: study the humanities｜学习人文学科
arts and humanities｜艺术与人文学科
tip: 统称学科领域常用the humanities，按复数处理。

senses.en: plants growing together in a particular area

ex.en: Office hours began with dense vegetation.
ex.zh: 答疑从茂密的植被开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss dense vegetation.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论茂密的植被的材料。

tip: 不可数名词，泛指某地区植物，不等于蔬菜。

senses.en: very small in amount, effect, or importance
outside the main or central part of something
only just good enough for a particular purpose

ex.en: Our professor circled marginal improvement on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了微小改善。

ex.en: The reading connects marginal improvement with a larger point about economic policy.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把微小改善和关于经济政策的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 表示变化时指幅度很小，不是完全没有变化。

senses.en: The ability to understand ideas, think logically, and solve problems.
A person with exceptional intelligence and reasoning ability.

ex.en: I copied a sharp intellect into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把敏锐的头脑抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects a sharp intellect with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把敏锐的头脑和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: intellect侧重理解与推理能力，不等同于知识。

senses.en: A difficult or frightening experience that lasts for some time.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a traumatic ordeal.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于造成心理创伤的经历的简答题。

ex.en: The author returns to a traumatic ordeal when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了造成心理创伤的经历。

col: go through an ordeal｜经历磨难
a traumatic ordeal｜造成心理创伤的经历
tip: 指令人痛苦或恐惧的经历，不用于普通的小麻烦。

senses.en: causing or influencing something without being immediately obvious
lying beneath the surface of something

ex.en: The textbook introduces underlying cause in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了根本原因。

ex.en: The author returns to underlying cause when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了根本原因。

tip: 通常放在名词前，强调表面现象背后的原因或基础。

senses.en: a change in shape caused by pressure or other forces

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on plastic deformation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论塑性变形。

ex.en: The reading connects plastic deformation with a larger point about the natural sciences.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把塑性变形和关于自然科学的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 强调形状改变，不等同于泛指损坏的damage。

senses.en: a particular area of knowledge, activity, or responsibility
an area controlled by a particular ruler or authority
an internet area identified by a shared name

ex.en: Office hours began with public domain.
ex.zh: 答疑从公有领域开始。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of public domain.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得公有领域这个例子。

col: the domain of science｜科学领域
tip: 领域义近field；in the public domain指公开可用。

senses.en: An infection that inflames the lungs and makes breathing difficult.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about develop pneumonia.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于患上肺炎的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used develop pneumonia to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用患上肺炎来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 词首p不发音；通常不可数，不说a pneumonia。

senses.en: To move, or make something move, in flowing circles.
A circular movement or a shape that curves around itself.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to swirl around.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须绕着打旋。

ex.en: When the class discussed the natural sciences, the speaker told us to swirl around.
ex.zh: 全班讨论自然科学时，讲者让我们绕着打旋。

col: a swirl of smoke｜一缕盘旋的烟
tip: 可作及物或不及物动词，强调流动中的旋转。

senses.en: to cause someone to give information or show a reaction

ex.en: The professor asked us to elicit a response.
ex.zh: 教授让我们引出回应。

ex.en: The passage says students who can elicit a response follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够引出回应的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 常接response等宾语；勿与illicit（非法的）混淆。

senses.en: to follow rules or meet required standards
to behave as others in a group expect

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to conform to standards.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何符合标准。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to conform to standards.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来符合标准。

col: pressure to conform｜要求随大流的压力
tip: 常用conform to rules或standards，不直接接宾语。

senses.en: Job loss because an employer no longer needs the position.
Unnecessary repetition or the presence of something not needed.
Extra components that keep a system working if others fail.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on compulsory redundancy.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论强制裁员。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss compulsory redundancy.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论强制裁员的材料。

tip: 英式英语常指裁员；技术语境可指保障运行的备用配置。

senses.en: belief in pursuing perfect standards, even when impractical
the philosophical view that reality depends on mind or consciousness

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about youthful idealism.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于年轻人的理想主义的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around youthful idealism.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕年轻人的理想主义展开说明。

col: youthful idealism｜年轻人的理想主义
a sense of idealism｜理想主义情怀
tip: 通常不可数；哲学语境译“唯心主义”。

senses.en: Using liquid pressure to produce movement or power.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about hydraulic pressure.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于液压的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss hydraulic pressure.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论液压的材料。

tip: hydraulic靠液体传压；pneumatic靠气体传压。

senses.en: without any payment being required
provided without requiring payment

ex.en: The lab manual says to gratis admission before you record the number.
ex.zh: 实验手册要求先免费入场，再记下数字。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy asks the class to gratis admission before trusting a chart.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座要求全班在相信图表之前先免费入场。

tip: 可作副词或形容词，较正式；日常通常用free。

senses.en: A reduction in the speed of activity or growth

ex.en: Our professor circled an economic slowdown on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了经济放缓。

ex.en: The author returns to an economic slowdown when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了经济放缓。

col: a slowdown in growth｜增长放缓
tip: slowdown是名词；动词短语写作slow down。

senses.en: to send someone or something to a destination
the act of sending people or goods somewhere
a report sent by a journalist or official

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to despatch goods.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须发运货物。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers despatch goods before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要发运货物。

col: despatch a rescue team｜派遣救援队
tip: despatch是dispatch的英式变体，后者更常见。

senses.en: A leopard or jaguar with a black coat.
A cougar, especially in North American usage.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about black panther.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于黑豹的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of black panther.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得黑豹这个例子。

tip: 黑豹通常是黑色的豹或美洲豹，并非独立物种。

senses.en: A statement or situation that seems contradictory but may be true.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about apparent paradox.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于表面上的矛盾的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of apparent paradox.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得表面上的矛盾这个例子。

col: present a paradox｜呈现看似矛盾的情况
tip: 强调看似矛盾却可能成立，不等于普通错误。

senses.en: to export goods that were previously imported

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to reexport goods.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须再出口商品。

ex.en: The reading asks you to reexport goods and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你再出口商品，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: reexport imported products｜将进口产品再出口
reexport to neighbouring markets｜再出口至邻近市场
tip: 也写作re-export，指进口后再出口。

senses.en: Limiting what people can do or what is allowed.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on overly restrictive.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论限制过多的。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around overly restrictive.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕限制过多的展开说明。

tip: 是形容词；restrictive强调施加限制。

senses.en: Apply oil or another substance to reduce friction between surfaces.

ex.en: The professor asked us to lubricate moving parts.
ex.zh: 教授让我们润滑活动部件。

ex.en: When the class discussed technological change, the speaker told us to lubricate moving parts.
ex.zh: 全班讨论技术变革时，讲者让我们润滑活动部件。

col: lubricate moving parts｜润滑活动部件
tip: 及物动词，直接接被润滑的部件；用with引出润滑剂。

senses.en: a wealthy and powerful person in a particular industry

ex.en: I copied a media magnate into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把媒体大亨抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: A campus survey used a media magnate to explain a pattern in economic policy.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用媒体大亨来解释经济政策中的一种模式。

tip: 常与行业名连用；注意不要与magnet（磁铁）混淆。

senses.en: To increase gradually, or receive benefits over time

ex.en: The lab instructions say to accrue benefits.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求逐渐获得益处。

ex.en: When the class discussed economic policy, the speaker told us to accrue benefits.
ex.zh: 全班讨论经济政策时，讲者让我们逐渐获得益处。

tip: 常用于利息、收益等逐渐累积；accrue to表示归于。

senses.en: To completely remove or destroy something harmful.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to eradicate disease.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须根除疾病。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to eradicate disease.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来根除疾病。

tip: 强调彻底消除，语气强于reduce，常用于疾病或贫困。

senses.en: the process of combining separate items into a larger whole
a group or collection of things brought together

ex.en: Our professor circled data aggregation on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了数据汇总。

ex.en: The author returns to data aggregation when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了数据汇总。

tip: 强调把分散项汇成整体；数据处理中常见。

senses.en: To notice or recognise something that is difficult to detect.

ex.en: The professor asked us to discern a pattern.
ex.zh: 教授让我们察觉规律。

ex.en: A lecture on academic research showed why researchers discern a pattern before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于学术研究的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要察觉规律。

tip: 较正式，强调费力看出或察觉不明显的事物。

senses.en: To honour a person or event by remembering them publicly

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to commemorate an event.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须纪念事件。

ex.en: A lecture on historical change showed why researchers commemorate an event before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于历史变迁的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要纪念事件。

tip: 直接接纪念对象；不一定含有庆祝的喜悦。

senses.en: To cause very severe damage to a place or thing
To make someone feel extremely upset or shocked

ex.en: The professor asked us to devastate a region.
ex.zh: 教授让我们重创一个地区。

ex.en: In the sample listening, the professor pauses to devastate a region.
ex.zh: 在示例听力里，教授停下来重创一个地区。

col: devastate a region｜重创一个地区
devastate the economy｜严重破坏经济
tip: 比damage程度重；也可指使人精神上受到重创。

senses.en: An area surrounded by a fence, wall, or other barrier.
Something placed inside an envelope together with a letter.
The act of surrounding land with a boundary.

ex.en: Our professor circled an animal enclosure on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了动物围场。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around an animal enclosure.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕动物围场展开说明。

tip: 纸质信函附件可用enclosure；邮件附件用attachment。

senses.en: gradually become weaker, smaller, or less important
show a progressively smaller illuminated part of the moon
a gradual decline, especially in the phrase on the wane

ex.en: The professor explained wane with a short example from campus.
ex.zh: 教授用一个简短的校园例子解释了减弱。

ex.en: Students who can explain wane usually follow the rest of a lecture on social change.
ex.zh: 能解释减弱的学生，通常跟得上一节关于社会变迁的讲座。

tip: 动词通常不及物；on the wane表示正在衰退。

senses.en: something offered to persuade someone to take a particular action

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on financial inducement.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论经济激励。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss financial inducement.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论经济激励的材料。

tip: 常指外部提供的奖励或好处，后可接to do。

senses.en: The belief that money and possessions matter most
The philosophical view that everything ultimately consists of matter

ex.en: Office hours began with consumer materialism.
ex.zh: 答疑从消费物质主义开始。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss consumer materialism.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论消费物质主义的材料。

tip: 消费话题常指物质至上；哲学语境指唯物主义。

senses.en: a position from which someone considers or judges something

ex.en: I wrote standpoint on a note card with its meaning.
ex.zh: 我把standpoint和它的意思写在了笔记卡上。

ex.en: The sample listening brings up standpoint while discussing evidence about academic research.
ex.zh: 示例听力在讨论关于学术研究的证据时提到了立场。

col: from a practical standpoint｜从实际角度看
from an economic standpoint｜从经济角度看
from someone's standpoint｜从某人的立场看
tip: 常用from a ... standpoint表示“从……角度看”。

senses.en: Harmful or making success and progress more difficult.

ex.en: Our professor circled adverse effects on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了不良影响。

ex.en: In the lecture on environmental policy, everyone remembered the example of adverse effects.
ex.zh: 在关于环境政策的讲座里，大家都记得不良影响这个例子。

col: adverse weather conditions｜恶劣天气状况
tip: adverse指不利的；averse指反感的，常接to。

senses.en: well arranged or behaving in a controlled, organised way
a hospital worker doing practical tasks, or a soldier's assistant

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on hospital orderly.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论医院护工。

ex.en: The reading connects hospital orderly with a larger point about social change.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把医院护工和关于社会变迁的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 虽以-ly结尾，常作形容词；名词可指医院护工。

senses.en: Friendly and polite, often in a formal situation.
A sweet concentrated fruit drink usually diluted with water.

ex.en: Our professor circled lime cordial on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了青柠浓缩饮料。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of lime cordial.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得青柠浓缩饮料这个例子。

tip: 形容友好态度较正式；名词在英国常指浓缩果饮。

senses.en: A freshwater fish with large scales, often kept in ponds.
To complain repeatedly about small or unimportant faults.

ex.en: Our professor circled common carp on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了普通鲤鱼。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of common carp.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得普通鲤鱼这个例子。

col: carp at minor faults｜挑小毛病
tip: 鱼名复数通常仍为carp；动词常接at。

senses.en: An office managing administrative work for a large organisation.

ex.en: Our professor circled a permanent secretariat on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了常设秘书处。

ex.en: In the lecture on public institutions, everyone remembered the example of a permanent secretariat.
ex.zh: 在关于公共制度的讲座里，大家都记得常设秘书处这个例子。

col: the committee secretariat｜委员会秘书处
tip: 指负责行政工作的机构，不是单个秘书。

senses.en: To reduce the quality or condition of something
To break down chemically into simpler substances
To treat someone as though they deserve no respect

ex.en: The assignment is to degrade soil quality, then say why it matters.
ex.zh: 作业是先降低土壤质量，再说明它为什么重要。

ex.en: When the class discussed environmental policy, the speaker told us to degrade soil quality.
ex.zh: 全班讨论环境政策时，讲者让我们降低土壤质量。

col: degrade soil quality｜降低土壤质量
tip: 表示质量下降时可及物；化学降解也可不及物。

senses.en: lift something heavy, often using ropes or machinery
a device used for lifting heavy objects

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to hoist a flag.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须升旗。

ex.en: The passage says students who can hoist a flag follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够升旗的学生更容易跟上论点。

tip: 强调费力抬起或借助绳索、机械吊起。

senses.zh: 癫痫等疾病的突然发作
senses.en: A sudden episode of abnormal electrical activity in the brain.
The act of taking something by force or legal authority.

ex.en: Office hours began with an epileptic seizure.
ex.zh: 答疑从癫痫发作开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used an epileptic seizure to explain a pattern in public health.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用癫痫发作来解释公共卫生中的一种模式。

tip: 医学义常搭配have；扣押某物用seizure of。

senses.en: having sides or parts that do not match
unequal between people, groups, or sides

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on asymmetric design.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论不对称设计。

ex.en: In the lecture on the humanities, everyone remembered the example of asymmetric design.
ex.zh: 在关于人文学科的讲座里，大家都记得不对称设计这个例子。

tip: 既可指形状不对称，也可指信息或力量不对等。

senses.en: Allowed by a rule, law, or accepted standard

ex.en: Office hours began with legally permissible.
ex.zh: 答疑从法律允许的开始。

ex.en: The author returns to legally permissible when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了法律允许的。

tip: 常用句型：It is permissible to do sth.。

senses.en: to become active or popular again, or make something so
to regain consciousness or energy, or help someone do so

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to revive the economy.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须振兴经济。

ex.en: The reading asks you to revive the economy and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你振兴经济，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: revive interest in｜重新激起对……的兴趣
tip: 既可及物也可不及物：revive a tradition；hopes revive。

senses.en: An art style showing subjects through geometric shapes and multiple viewpoints.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about the development of cubism.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于立体主义的发展的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used the development of cubism to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用立体主义的发展来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: the development of cubism｜立体主义的发展
tip: 通常不可数；cubist 可指立体派艺术家或作形容词。

senses.en: A member of a senate, a lawmaking body

ex.en: The textbook introduces a senior senator in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了资深参议员。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a senior senator.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕资深参议员展开说明。

col: serve as a senator｜担任参议员
tip: senator是参议员；senate指参议院。

senses.en: To make someone or something completely wet

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to drench someone with water.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须用水把某人浇透。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers drench someone with water before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要用水把某人浇透。

col: drench someone with water｜用水把某人浇透
tip: 强调完全湿透；常用被动形式be drenched。

senses.en: An evergreen tree with needle-shaped leaves, or its wood.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a fir tree.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于一棵冷杉的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss a fir tree.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论一棵冷杉的材料。

tip: fir是冷杉；fur才是毛皮，两词同音。

senses.en: to refer to something without mentioning it directly

ex.en: The professor asked us to allude to a problem.
ex.zh: 教授让我们间接提及问题。

ex.en: The reading asks you to allude to a problem and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你间接提及问题，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: allude to a problem｜间接提及问题
allude to the past｜隐约谈及过去
tip: 固定用allude to，不直接接宾语；勿混elude。

senses.en: A process of voting, usually in secret.
A paper or electronic form used to record a vote.
To ask people to vote, or to vote yourself.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on secret ballot.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论无记名投票。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss secret ballot.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论无记名投票的材料。

tip: ballot侧重投票程序或选票；by secret ballot指无记名投票。

senses.en: an underwater weapon that propels itself towards a target
to deliberately cause a plan or agreement to fail

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about torpedo tube.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于鱼雷发射管的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around torpedo tube.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕鱼雷发射管展开说明。

tip: 鱼雷是torpedo；水雷是mine。复数为torpedoes。

senses.en: A long pipe carrying liquids or gas between places.
A system through which things are supplied or developed.

ex.en: The textbook introduces a gas pipeline in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了天然气管道。

ex.en: In the lecture on technological change, everyone remembered the example of a gas pipeline.
ex.zh: 在关于技术变革的讲座里，大家都记得天然气管道这个例子。

tip: in the pipeline常指项目正在筹备或推进中。

senses.en: A man holding a low-ranking title of nobility.
A wealthy person with great power in a particular industry.

ex.en: Our professor circled a media baron on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了传媒大亨。

ex.en: The author returns to a media baron when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了传媒大亨。

tip: 本义为男爵；行业名词加baron可指该行业大亨。

senses.en: In a way that suggests superiority to other people.

ex.en: The professor told us to arrogantly dismiss and then compare notes.
ex.zh: 教授让我们傲慢地否定，然后比较笔记。

ex.en: The reading shows why a careful writer will arrogantly dismiss when the evidence is thin.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读说明，证据不足时，谨慎的作者会傲慢地否定。

tip: 带贬义；自信地通常用confidently。

senses.en: To follow a rule, belief, or agreement closely.
To stick firmly to a surface.

ex.en: Before Friday's seminar, our group has to adhere to guidelines.
ex.zh: 周五研讨课之前，我们小组必须遵循指导原则。

ex.en: The reading asks you to adhere to guidelines and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你遵循指导原则，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: adhere to guidelines｜遵循指导原则
adhere to a surface｜黏附于表面
tip: 两种常见义都用adhere to；to是介词。

senses.en: covered with or containing many stones
showing no warmth, sympathy, or emotion

ex.en: The textbook introduces stony ground in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了多石的土地。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss stony ground.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论多石的土地的材料。

col: a stony path｜满是石头的小路
tip: stony silence 指冷漠或不悦的沉默，并非普通安静。

senses.en: Make someone unable to move all or part of their body.
Prevent a system from functioning or a person from acting.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer paralyze transport during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时使交通瘫痪。

ex.en: The passage says students who can paralyze transport follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够使交通瘫痪的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: paralyzed by fear｜吓得无法动弹
tip: 美式拼写paralyze；英式通常写paralyse。

senses.en: A local church district, or a small administrative area.
The people living in a particular church district.

ex.en: Our professor circled parish church on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了堂区教堂。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of parish church.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得堂区教堂这个例子。

tip: 教会语境指堂区，比主教管辖的diocese小。

senses.en: An exciting attractiveness associated with beauty, wealth, or fame.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about Hollywood glamour.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于好莱坞式的华丽魅力的简答题。

ex.en: A campus survey used Hollywood glamour to explain a pattern in the humanities.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用好莱坞式的华丽魅力来解释人文学科中的一种模式。

col: the glamour of fame｜名声的光环
Hollywood glamour｜好莱坞式的华丽魅力
tip: 通常不可数；美式也写glamor。

senses.en: Worry that something unpleasant may happen.
The act of catching and arresting someone suspected of a crime.

ex.en: Office hours began with a sense of apprehension.
ex.zh: 答疑从忧虑感开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used a sense of apprehension to explain a pattern in human behavior.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用忧虑感来解释人类行为中的一种模式。

tip: 常指对未来的担忧，常接about；逮捕义较正式。

senses.en: To protect someone or something from harm or loss.
A measure that prevents harm, loss, or unfair treatment.

ex.en: The lab instructions say to safeguard rights.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求保障权利。

ex.en: A lecture on public institutions showed why researchers safeguard rights before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于公共制度的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要保障权利。

col: safeguard personal information｜保护个人信息
a safeguard against fraud｜防范欺诈的措施
tip: 动词常接权益等宾语；名词常接against表示防范对象。

senses.en: The process of entering or passing through something.
The extent to which a product reaches a market.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about water penetration.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于水分渗透的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss water penetration.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论水分渗透的材料。

tip: 由penetrate派生；常用penetration of或into。

senses.en: The loss of power, success, or social position.
Something that causes a person or organisation to fail.

ex.en: The textbook introduces lead to someone's downfall in the first chapter.
ex.zh: 教材在第一章介绍了导致某人垮台。

ex.en: The author returns to lead to someone's downfall when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了导致某人垮台。

col: lead to someone's downfall｜导致某人垮台
bring about the downfall of｜促使……败落
prove to be someone's downfall｜最终成为某人失败的原因
tip: 指垮台或败因；倾盆大雨应说downpour。

senses.en: Intense anger caused by something deeply unfair or wrong
To make someone extremely angry through unacceptable behaviour
An act that is shockingly wrong or unacceptable

ex.en: Our professor circled public outrage on the slide.
ex.zh: 教授在幻灯片上圈出了公众的愤慨。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around public outrage.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕公众的愤慨展开说明。

col: an outrage against humanity｜反人类暴行
tip: 表愤慨通常不可数；an outrage指骇人行径。

senses.en: An urgent, emotional request for something.
A formal statement admitting or denying guilt in court.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a guilty plea.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论认罪答辩。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a guilty plea.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕认罪答辩展开说明。

col: a plea for help｜恳求帮助
enter a plea｜正式作出答辩
tip: plea for后接所求之物；plea to后接请求对象。

senses.en: to make an activity illegal
a criminal who lives outside the law

ex.en: The lab instructions say to outlaw a practice.
ex.zh: 实验说明要求禁止某种做法。

ex.en: The reading asks you to outlaw a practice and then check a second source.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读要求你禁止某种做法，然后再核对第二个来源。

col: outlaw a practice｜禁止某种做法
outlaw discrimination｜宣布歧视行为非法
a notorious outlaw｜臭名昭著的逃犯
tip: 作动词时直接接被禁止的行为或事物。

senses.en: Treating all sides fairly without favouring anyone.

ex.en: Office hours began with impartial advice.
ex.zh: 答疑从公正的建议开始。

ex.en: The author returns to impartial advice when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了公正的建议。

tip: partial 可表示偏袒的；impartial 表示不偏袒。

senses.en: A difference between opinions, approaches, or developments.
Movement apart in different directions from a common point.

ex.en: I copied growing divergence into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把不断扩大的差异抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: The reading connects growing divergence with a larger point about academic research.
ex.zh: 这篇阅读把不断扩大的差异和关于学术研究的一个更大的问题联系起来。

tip: 常用between连接差异双方；动词为diverge。

senses.en: To make something appear larger, especially through a lens.
To make something seem more important or become more serious.

ex.en: The professor asked us to magnify an image.
ex.zh: 教授让我们放大图像。

ex.en: A lecture on the natural sciences showed why researchers magnify an image before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于自然科学的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要放大图像。

tip: 既可指视觉放大，也可指夸大问题或加剧影响。

senses.en: Honest and direct, even about uncomfortable subjects.
Photographed naturally without being asked to pose.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on a candid assessment.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论坦率的评估。

ex.en: In the lecture on social change, everyone remembered the example of a candid assessment.
ex.zh: 在关于社会变迁的讲座里，大家都记得坦率的评估这个例子。

tip: 谈人或言论指坦率；谈照片指非摆拍。

senses.en: To feel deep sadness, especially after someone's death
To cause someone deep sadness

ex.en: In office hours we practiced how to grieve over a loss.
ex.zh: 答疑时我们练习如何为失去而悲伤。

ex.en: A lecture on human behavior showed why researchers grieve over a loss before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于人类行为的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要为失去而悲伤。

col: grieve over a loss｜为失去而悲伤
tip: grieve for常接逝者；grieve over常接损失或不幸。

senses.en: Not physically touchable or easily measured, but still real or valuable

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on intangible benefits.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论无形的益处。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of intangible benefits.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得无形的益处这个例子。

col: intangible cultural heritage｜非物质文化遗产
tip: 不仅指摸不到，也指价值等难以量化。

senses.en: to bring a feeling, memory or image into someone's mind

ex.en: The professor asked us to evoke memories.
ex.zh: 教授让我们唤起回忆。

ex.en: Careful notes from the talk include a reminder to evoke memories.
ex.zh: 听课笔记里写着要记得唤起回忆。

tip: 直接接情感、回忆等宾语，不加of。

senses.en: Likely or hoping to become something in the future.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about prospective students.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于有意入学的学生的简答题。

ex.en: Students compared two sources that both discuss prospective students.
ex.zh: 学生比较了两份都讨论有意入学的学生的材料。

tip: 常放名词前；勿与perspective“视角”混淆。

senses.en: A person or company paid to move furniture and belongings.
Someone who actively helps make a change or project happen.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a prime mover.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于主要推动者的简答题。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around a prime mover.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕主要推动者展开说明。

col: movers and shakers｜有影响力的人物
tip: 搬家工人义多见于美式；prime mover指主要推动者。

senses.en: a person living in an area represented by an elected official
one of the parts or substances that form something
forming part of a larger whole

ex.en: Office hours began with a major constituent.
ex.zh: 答疑从主要成分开始。

ex.en: The author returns to a major constituent when explaining the conclusion.
ex.zh: 作者在解释结论时又回到了主要成分。

tip: 选民义可含未投票的选区居民；成分义近component。

senses.en: Familiar with a subject and able to discuss it

ex.en: Office hours began with conversant with.
ex.zh: 答疑从熟悉……的开始。

ex.en: The listening passage defines the discussion around conversant with.
ex.zh: 这段听力材料围绕熟悉……的展开说明。

tip: 常用be conversant with，表示熟悉某领域，并非有交情。

senses.en: The study of speech sounds and how people produce them.

ex.en: Office hours began with articulatory phonetics.
ex.zh: 答疑从发音语音学开始。

ex.en: A campus survey used articulatory phonetics to explain a pattern in academic research.
ex.zh: 一项校园调查用发音语音学来解释学术研究中的一种模式。

tip: 虽以-s结尾，作学科名时通常接单数谓语。

senses.en: Careful thought or discussion before making a decision.
A slow, careful, and intentional way of doing something.

ex.en: I copied after much deliberation into my lecture notes.
ex.zh: 我把经过反复考虑抄进了课堂笔记。

ex.en: In the lecture on academic research, everyone remembered the example of after much deliberation.
ex.zh: 在关于学术研究的讲座里，大家都记得经过反复考虑这个例子。

col: after much deliberation｜经过反复考虑
tip: 表商议过程可用复数deliberations；勿一律译为故意。

senses.en: Something that limits what you can do.
Control that prevents free or natural behaviour.

ex.en: The quiz had a short question about a constraint on growth.
ex.zh: 小测里有一道关于对增长的制约的简答题。

ex.en: In the lecture on economic policy, everyone remembered the example of a constraint on growth.
ex.zh: 在关于经济政策的讲座里，大家都记得对增长的制约这个例子。

col: a constraint on growth｜对增长的制约
within budget constraints｜在预算限制内
tip: 常用复数constraints；对……的限制用on。

senses.en: The production of new plants or other living organisms.
The spreading of ideas, information, or beliefs.
The movement of waves or signals through a medium.

ex.en: The seminar spent a few minutes on plant propagation.
ex.zh: 研讨课花了几分钟讨论植物繁殖。

ex.en: In the lecture on the natural sciences, everyone remembered the example of plant propagation.
ex.zh: 在关于自然科学的讲座里，大家都记得植物繁殖这个例子。

tip: 通常不可数；可用于植物繁殖、信息传播及波传播。

senses.en: To discourage an action by making it seem difficult or risky.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer deter crime during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时遏制犯罪。

ex.en: The passage says students who can deter crime follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够遏制犯罪的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: deter someone from doing something｜阻止某人做某事
deter potential customers｜使潜在顾客却步
tip: 用deter sb from doing；过去式为deterred。

senses.en: to stop considering or working on something for now
to put something on a shelf

ex.en: I heard the lecturer shelve a plan during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时搁置计划。

ex.en: A lecture on economic policy showed why researchers shelve a plan before they publish.
ex.zh: 关于经济政策的讲座说明了研究者为什么在发表之前要搁置计划。

col: shelve a proposal｜暂缓考虑提案
tip: shelve作动词；shelf是名词，复数为shelves。

senses.en: To live in a place in large, harmful or unwanted groups.

ex.en: I heard the lecturer infest crops during the example.
ex.zh: 我听到讲者在举例时侵害庄稼。

ex.en: The passage says students who can infest crops follow the argument more easily.
ex.zh: 文章说，能够侵害庄稼的学生更容易跟上论点。

col: be infested with rats｜老鼠成灾
tip: 常用be infested with，主语是受虫鼠侵扰处。
